description: Lightning component interaction recipes (founding doc section 7) and flake control (section 10). Hubs: hub_sf_components; flake atoms go to hub_sf_antipatterns.

atoms.payload: [V-O blueprint / V-M pattern] lightning-combobox (picklists) is NOT a native <select>; selectOption() does not work. Pattern: await page.getByLabel(label).click(); await page.getByRole('option', {name: option, exact: true}).click(). Rendered DOM: trigger with role='combobox' + aria-expanded, popup [role='listbox'] > [role='option']. Scope to the owning container (dialog, tabpanel) when the label repeats on the page.

[V-M] Lookup / typeahead fields: click the combobox trigger, fill(searchText), let the async search populate the listbox, then click the matching role='option'. Playwright's auto-wait on the option click absorbs the search XHR — no explicit network wait needed. Do not assert listbox contents before the option click; the click IS the synchronization point.

[V-M] Modals: scope every locator to page.getByRole('dialog') while the modal is open (const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog'); dialog.getByLabel(...)). After save, assert the dialog is hidden — await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toBeHidden() — before asserting any downstream state; the close is the transaction boundary.

[V-O] Datatable: locate rows via getByRole('row', {name: /distinctive text/}), cells within a row via [data-label='ColumnLabel']; grid variants use role='grid' and role='gridcell'. Datatable internals are under active performance rework — expect churn; stay on roles and data-label, never internal structure.

[S] Date picker: fill() the input directly with a locale-formatted date string, then press Escape to close the calendar overlay — do not click through the calendar grid (slow, locale-fragile, and the grid layout churns). The test user's pinned locale determines the accepted format.

[V-M mechanism] File upload: bypass the drag-drop surface entirely; call locator('input[type="file"]').setInputFiles(filePath) on the hidden input, then assert the '1 of 1 file uploaded' confirmation text before closing the dialog.
[S] Rich text editor: target [contenteditable='true'] inside lightning-input-rich-text and fill/type there — not on the host element, whose fill silently does nothing.

[S] Tabs: click role='tab', then assert the corresponding role='tabpanel' is visible BEFORE touching fields inside it — inactive panels may not be rendered at all (lazy render), so locators into an unactivated panel resolve to nothing.

[V-M] Visualforce embedded in LEX: page.frameLocator('iframe[title*="..."]') or page.frameLocator('iframe[name^="vfFrameId"]'), then locate inside. The frame content is classic DOM with stable developer-authored ids — classic locator rules (ids allowed) apply inside the frame only.

[S] Path stage completion: click the target stage chevron, click 'Mark as Complete' / 'Mark Stage as Complete', assert the success toast immediately, then verify the persisted StageName via SOQL — the toast alone does not prove the stage stuck (validation rules can revert).

[V-M] lightning-input hosts a native <input> inside its (synthetic) shadow root, and getByLabel() resolves through to it — label-based fill works on Lightning form fields with no shadow gymnastics. The same holds for most lightning-* form controls because their blueprints wire label-for correctly.

[V-M] Flake root-cause -> fix map for Salesforce Playwright: racing the render -> web-first assertions + spinner waits. Toast raced past -> assert immediately (4.8s window). Stale handles after re-render -> never store handles; locators re-resolve. Data collisions -> unique per-run names + per-worker users + API cleanup. Session expiry mid-run -> generous session timeout + state validation/refresh. Login flake -> token injection, never per-test UI login. Diagnose by matching the failure signature to this table BEFORE adding timeouts anywhere.

[V-O] Playwright already isolates browser state per test (fresh context every test). In Salesforce the real isolation problem is SERVER-SIDE org data shared across tests and workers — records, list views, personal settings, locks. Solve with per-worker users, unique record naming, and API cleanup; browser-profile tricks cannot help.

[S] Never click by coordinates on Salesforce UI: WCAG 2.2 work (Summer '25) made modals reflow at zoom levels, so pixel positions shift across zoom/viewport/theme. Click locators, not points; if a click needs coordinates, the locator is wrong.
